nodes.title: Background
nodes.summary:
This partial document outlines a tender issued by the Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL) for electrical works related to the Phase II extension of the Namma Metro. Key points include:

*   **Objective:** Invitation for sealed tenders from eligible contractors to handle the design, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems for selected stations.
*   **Scope of Work:** The contractor is required to provide electrical infrastructure including station lighting systems, power distribution panels, emergency backup systems, and earthing and lightning protection.
*   **Location:** The project will be executed at selected stations along the North–South corridor in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
*   **Process:** The document begins to outline instructions for bidders, specifically mentioning bid submission procedures.

Mode of Submission

structure.title: Eligibility Criteria

nodes.title: Financial Qualification
Minimum Turnover
nodes.summary: This partial document outlines the qualification criteria and scope for a bidding process, divided into financial and technical requirements. Financially, the bidder must demonstrate a minimum annual turnover of INR 100 crore over the last three years, maintain a positive net worth for the previous financial year, and submit audited balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and auditor certification. Technically, the bidder is required to have successfully completed at least two similar electrical infrastructure projects in metro rail or large infrastructure within the last seven years, with each project having a minimum contract value of INR 30 crore. Additionally, the bidder must possess qualified engineers specializing in electrical engineering, power systems, and safety compliance. The document also introduces the "Scope of Work" section.

nodes.title: Electrical Power Distribution
Main Distribution Panels
nodes.summary:
This partial document outlines technical specifications and payment terms for an electrical project. Key sections include:

*   **Electrical Power Distribution:** Requirements for supplying and installing main Low Tension (LT) distribution panels in designated station rooms, along with cabling that must comply with Indian Standards and metro safety regulations.
*   **Station Lighting Systems:** Specifications for installing LED lighting fixtures on passenger platforms and ensuring emergency lighting activates automatically during power failures.
*   **Earthing and Lightning Protection:** Mandates for installing a complete earthing system to ensure safe equipment operation and the installation of lightning arrestors according to relevant safety standards.
*   **Payment Terms:** Details regarding an advance payment of 10% of the contract value, which is conditional upon the submission of a bank guarantee.

It also provides contact details for the Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL), identifying the procurement department as the tender issuing authority and directing all communications to their official office in Bengaluru.
